hypothesis: A joint product RBF kernel on all three radar embeddings captures class-relevant interactions that an additive per-radar kernel cannot; assess transfer on a held validation user before opening test predictions.
status: exploratory mechanism screen, not novel algorithm
input: existing fold-specific LTR encoder features; no other-fold encoder or test-fitted statistics
split: test=h; validation=h%8+1; training=other six; original 9300 quality mask
bandwidth: per-view median squared distance among 2048 deterministic source pairs after source-only coordinate standardization
capacity: same 384 source landmarks, Nystrom eigenvalue floor 1e-10, 384-dimensional readout for each kernel
training: class/user-balanced squared loss on one-hot targets, intercept unpenalized; no domain alignment penalty
selection: maximize validation present-class macro accuracy; ties use first alpha
test_policy: Only evaluate selected models on outer test rows if global validation gate passes. Gate failing means stop this screen without a new outer-test metric. Existing cache integrity audits may replay historical baseline.
limits: Eight users already have development history; old encoders used same validation users for early stopping. This is not independent external validation. Product kernel and Nystrom are established methods. Do not claim novelty from a positive screen.
followup_if_pass: fixed seed 2027 landmark repeat, paired user uncertainty, raw-signal end-to-end matched CE investigation; no grid expansion based on outer-test scores
budget: CPU 3 BLAS threads; one seed eight validation folds, no paid compute
repeat: Preplanned landmark sampling repeat; encoder is unchanged seed2026. Both primary and repeat will be reported irrespective of repeat gate; primary gate already passed.
